notes: Flags: none. Fit: stands on the storage piece (the VIHALS sideboard, 18.5" deep, or the KALLAX top), so the layouts draw it on the top layer; 12.5" tall beside the art. Artificial, so nothing to water, no soil for a 4-year-old to dig and no leaves to chew: PEVA and polyethylene leaves in a polypropylene inner pot; wipe clean. Indoor/outdoor. The page's 'Complete with' offers a PERSILLADE plant pot, 4 3/4", light beige, $6.99 (/us/en/p/persillade-plant-pot-light-beige-90606797/), not captured. Not badged; 4.6 stars (13); found on the FEJKA search (the Artificial plants list's top sellers are 2-3" hanging plants and succulents; the floor-size FEJKA bamboo and bird of paradise, both Best sellers, are $89.99). In stock in IKEA Long Island, NY on 2026-10-22. rooms: dining-room, from the staging brief.
